scope: Unified Hadamard Maximal Determinant Catalog for orders 1 <= n <= 120
normalization: D_norm = |det(X)| / 2^(n-1) for X in {-1, +1}^(n x n) (OEIS A003432); det_exact = |det(X)| (OEIS A003433)
